metadata.description: Björn Hansen's personal collection of reusable Claude Code skills.

plugins.name: autonomous-pr-review
plugins.description: Generic autonomous PR review methodology: verify before flagging, check PR-description metadata against the repo's own documented conventions, recognize restraint the repo's own style deliberately practices, and post findings with mandatory inline anchoring plus a mechanically-derived verdict. Repo-agnostic — pairs with a repo-specific companion skill for domain invariants.

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: One structure for every audit (UI/UX, security, performance, code health): a committed six-part report and local-only evidence. Visual evidence comes from the repo's own `make screenshots-audit` (visual-kit). Repo-agnostic; each repo keeps only an index in docs/audit/.

plugins.name: visual-check
plugins.description: Per-change visual check for UI work: render the touched routes on the merge base and on the working tree in one pinned image, read the diff and the axe/console/overflow deltas, and write the PR's Visual check section. Also README and landing-page screenshots from the same pipeline (visual-kit).
